scope: Proposition 7.3 (All exponential passage moments) of the manuscript “Self-dual random-cluster interfaces below one” (preprints/Self-dual-random-cluster-interfaces-below-one-September-23-2026/paper.pdf), one of the manuscripts of result family 223 of openai/math at commit 1581d4cbdd69. The statement is quoted verbatim from the text that pdftotext 24.02.0 (-raw -enc UTF-8) extracts from the PDF (SHA-256 bf15a86507a10184), with whitespace normalised, and was found there under this heading on PDF page 102. Text extraction flattens typeset mathematics (superscripts, subscripts, fractions, large operators, delimiters), so the quote can read differently from the typeset statement and can carry characters with no Unicode meaning; the PDF is authoritative. Finding the quote shows that the manuscript states it, not that it is true. AMVO has checked nothing about this claim.
statement: For every fixed buffered regular annulus or sector and every B ≥ 0, its passage count X satisfies E h eBX | exterior states i ≤ CB. (7.1) The estimate is uniform in scale, sufficiently fine mesh, and the compatible exterior states. It also holds for the fixed macroscopic diameter tests of Definition 7.2, for a fixed finite family of such tests, and for an inventory with the stated fixed domination by their packing counts.
